comment: Monthly issues published before the QA tool existed. Between them they carry
182 unobserved images and 34 unresolved sections; retrofitting that evidence
would be invented, not observed, so they are grandfathered instead.
This list may SHRINK - never grow. The enforcement cutoff itself lives in
scripts/monthly-blog-qa.py (ENFORCEMENT_START), so exempting a new post can
never be a single edit here: a slug at or after the cutoff fails validation.
August 2026 is the first gated issue and is deliberately absent.
